transforms.name: adapter-step-0
transforms.effect: usage_update.used and size are context occupancy, not usage-family tokens.

transforms.name: adapter-step-1
transforms.effect: finiteNonNegative keeps 0 and drops NaN and negatives. capacityTokens is kept only when size > 0.

transforms.name: adapter-step-2
transforms.effect: The monitor upsert is emitted when either used or positive size is present. percentageSource is derived only when both are present, otherwise unavailable.

transforms.name: adapter-step-3
transforms.effect: The pipeline emits context-window:updated only when both used >= 0 and size > 0. Otherwise it emits adapter:native-event.
